name: learn-toolkit
description: One skill, /learn <subject>, that researches a topic with domain-aware tool routing (tech, philosophy, judaism), fans research out across Tavily, Exa, Sefaria and Trove (plus an optional self-hosted web-research server), and optionally builds a NotebookLM learning package.

exa_api_key.title: Exa API key
exa_api_key.description: From https://dashboard.exa.ai/api-keys. Leave blank to use Exa's free keyless tier (rate-limited); --deep research needs a key.

tavily_api_key.title: Tavily API key
tavily_api_key.description: From https://app.tavily.com. Leave blank to use the tvly CLI; keyless search and extract work without login. Use tvly login or tvly init --agent claude-code for full CLI access.

web_research_url.title: web-research server URL
web_research_url.description: Optional. The MCP URL of your own self-hosted web-research server (16 extra tools: batch search, crawling, package and repo lookups). Setup: https://github.com/yodem/learn-toolkit/tree/main/infra/web-research. Leave blank to skip it; /learn then runs on Tavily and Exa alone.

web_research_token.title: web-research bearer token
web_research_token.description: Optional. The bearer token (WRA_TOKEN) of your web-research server; see https://github.com/yodem/learn-toolkit/tree/main/infra/web-research. Leave blank if you left the URL blank.
